preconditions.description: The number of strings in the array A is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Each string in the array A has a length between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in A)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array A is a string.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == len(A[0]) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All strings in the array A have the same length.

postconditions.description: The result is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of columns to delete to ensure all remaining columns form a lexicographically sorted array.
The result is not greater than the number of columns in the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(all(A[i][k] <= A[i][l] for l in range(k + 1, len(A[i]))) for k in range(len(A[i])) for i in range(len(A)))
postconditions.description: The output ensures that after deleting the specified columns, each row in the resulting array is lexicographically sorted.
